name: MARGINAL#4 ROAD TO GALAXY
source:
The story begins two years after Kataoka Yue joined the talent production company “Pythagoras Productions”. She’s worked her way up and now helps manage two of the company’s most popular groups – Marginal#4 & Lagrange Point. One day, Yue and the group members are all called into the company president’s office and introduced to a new group called “Unicorn Jr.” who will have their début at this year’s “Universe Fes”. Once the introductions are over with and everyone leaves the office, the president holds Yue back and tells her that she will be in charge of organising a huge event called “Pythagoras ✰ All Star Fes” featuring all three groups. As she only has 6 months to prepare, the president tells her that she can only be in charge of one group at the moment and asks her choose between the three. Which will she choose?

[from [url=https://zettairenai.wordpress.com/2017/06/03/ps-vita-marginal4-road-to-galaxy-review/]Zettai Renai[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在片冈由依加入艺能制作公司“Pythagoras Productions”两年后。她一路晋升，如今负责管理公司最受欢迎的两个组合——Marginal#4与Lagrange Point。

一天，由依和组合成员被叫进社长办公室，认识了名为Unicorn Jr.的新组合。她们将在今年的“Universe Fes”上出道。介绍结束、其他人离开后，社长留下由依，告诉她要负责筹备一场由三组艺人共同出演的大型活动“Pythagoras☆All Star Fes”。

由于准备时间只有6个月，社长要求她暂时只能负责一个组合，并让她在三者中选择。她会选择谁？

（来源：[url=https://zettairenai.wordpress.com/2017/06/03/ps-vita-marginal4-road-to-galaxy-review/]Zettai Renai[/url]）
